what: MokoRus's code located and moved (bn4_chips.h BN4_MOKORUS 0x080D252A, BN4_T3_MOKO 0x2C, BN4_MOKO_HIT_BITS 0x080D23E0), the bytes' shuffle paired (BN4_SHUFFLE 0x08000AAA, BN6_SHUFFLE 0x08000C72) and the struck pass's push read in both (BN4_STRUCK_PUSHED 0x0801360C: bit 0x01 with a push bit; BN6_STRUCK_PUSHED 0x0801AC06: bit 0x40 with one; docs/rom/bn4.md).
